description: The scorecard dimensions for japan_ski_property, each scored 0-10. Definitions are recorded here so that a score means the same thing across markets, across sessions and across agents. What each score is derived from is stated, so a score can be challenged on its evidence rather than argued about as an opinion.

affordability.label: Affordability
affordability.definition: Entry price for a property capable of the intended operating model, relative to other candidate markets.
affordability.high_score_means: Viable stock available well below the candidate-market median.

ski_quality.label: Ski quality
ski_quality.definition: Terrain quality, variety and scale for a competent snowboarder, including access to nearby linked resorts.
ski_quality.high_score_means: A serious snowboarder would happily spend seven days here.

snow_reliability.label: Snow reliability
snow_reliability.definition: Measured snowfall, season length and multi-year trend. Weighted toward meteorological records over marketing figures.
snow_reliability.high_score_means: Deep, consistent, long season with no adverse measured trend.

tourism_growth.label: Tourism growth
tourism_growth.definition: Trajectory of visitation and overnight stays, domestic and international.
tourism_growth.high_score_means: Sustained, evidenced growth rather than a single-year rebound.

rental_demand.label: Rental demand
rental_demand.definition: Depth of demand for the accommodation product the owners would operate.
rental_demand.high_score_means: Strong demand across a full season, not only peak weeks.

winter_occupancy.label: Winter occupancy
winter_occupancy.definition: Achievable occupancy during the core season for a well-run property.
winter_occupancy.high_score_means: High occupancy achievable without discounting to fill.

off_season_demand.label: Off-season demand
off_season_demand.definition: Measured April-November demand. Plans and strategies do not count.
off_season_demand.high_score_means: Genuine four-season trading, evidenced by measured visitation.

accessibility.label: Accessibility
accessibility.definition: Ease of arrival from Australia: airport transfer time, transfer options, and friction on arrival.
accessibility.high_score_means: Simple, reliable transfer that does not require guests to drive on snow.

amenities.label: Amenities
amenities.definition: Substance of the town: food, groceries, medical, services, and whether they are walkable.
amenities.high_score_means: Guests can live comfortably for a week without a car.

town_vibe.label: Town vibe
town_vibe.definition: Whether guests enjoy being there, and would return. Subjective, corroborated across independent sources.
town_vibe.high_score_means: Somewhere guests recommend, not merely tolerate.

management_availability.label: Management availability
management_availability.definition: Whether competent local management, cleaning and maintenance demonstrably exist.
management_availability.high_score_means: Multiple credible providers, so the owners are not dependent on one person.
management_availability.gating_note: A market with no identified providers cannot be operated remotely and is disqualified, not merely scored low.

regulation.label: Regulation
regulation.definition: Whether the intended commercial operating model is lawful and licensable for the property type.
regulation.high_score_means: Clear, obtainable licensing with transferable licences available.
regulation.gating_note: Where the operating model cannot be made lawful, the subject is disqualified regardless of every other score.

renovation_opportunity.label: Renovation opportunity
renovation_opportunity.definition: Scope to add value through renovation at a cost that is manageable and reasonably estimable.
renovation_opportunity.high_score_means: Meaningful uplift available for a cost that is both affordable and predictable.

property_price_momentum.label: Property price momentum
property_price_momentum.definition: Direction and rate of change in land and property values.
property_price_momentum.high_score_means: Evidence of a turning or rising market, not a decade of decline.

business_growth.label: Business growth
business_growth.definition: Whether private capital is actually entering the town: net business formation, openings and closures.
business_growth.high_score_means: Net formation, especially in hospitality and accommodation.

infrastructure.label: Infrastructure
infrastructure.definition: Committed transport, lift and tourism infrastructure, weighted by development status.
infrastructure.high_score_means: Funded or under-construction projects, not announcements.

future_supply_balance.label: Future supply balance
future_supply_balance.definition: Forward accommodation supply against demand growth. High supply growth scores low.
future_supply_balance.high_score_means: Demand growing faster than committed new supply.

capital_growth_potential.label: Capital growth potential
capital_growth_potential.definition: Prospects for appreciation over 10-15 years on evidenced drivers, not narrative.
capital_growth_potential.high_score_means: Multiple independent drivers pointing the same way.

exit_liquidity.label: Exit liquidity
exit_liquidity.definition: Whether a plausible buyer exists in 10-15 years, and how hard the sale would be.
exit_liquidity.high_score_means: An active, identifiable buyer pool beyond foreign speculators.

risk.label: Risk (inverted)
risk.definition: Aggregate downside exposure. Scored inverted: 10 means low risk.

gating_note: Failing a gating component disqualifies the subject outright. A market where the operating model is not legal, or cannot be run remotely, is not a worse option — it is not an option.
